ANASTOMOSIS.MD · IN THE WILD · AVATAR-FIRST · 23 OCT 2026

Born in the profile view.

Per the new rule: every mark is now created inside the Instagram profile view — because that is where it will live or die. The rendered 3D style is dropped. What remains: flat marks, one subject, centered, built for the circle.

The research, applied.

  • The circle crop is a filter, not a container — the mark lives in the central ~65% with breathing room; corners are dead territory.
  • At 110 px, detail dies — one subject, strong shapes, high contrast; the avatar is the symbol, never the full lockup.
  • The 5-second test — a stranger should be able to draw the mark from memory after seeing it once.
  • One square icon everywhere — the same 800×800 asset serves every platform.
  • 2–3 colours, negative space, symbol built into the form — the freshest medical marks integrate, never decorate.
THE DESIGNER’S CUT · MY CHOICE · FULL FREEDOM

One tube. Two colours. One golden join.

With the restrictions lifted, this is the design I would ship: the artery that ties itself into the vein — the founder’s infinity, the vessel language, and the avatar discipline, fused into a single knot. The name, performed by the mark itself.

DC-1

The self-tying vessel

One continuous vessel: artery in through the golden ring, vein out — the founder's infinity, tied with the full vessel language: curve, taper, branch, open mouths.

One tube, two colours, one join — drawable from memory in five seconds.

DC-2

The name carries the loop

The complete lockup: the self-tying vessel as avatar, and the wordmark whose two O's are the loops — crimson and petrol, joined behind the M.

Typography performing the name's own meaning.

DC-3

The hidden monogram

The loop composed so the negative space beneath the crossing whispers an A — a reward for the second look.

The best marks hide something; this one hides the initial.

DC-4

The launch post

The hero post: the mark large, the line beneath — 'Two vessels. One mind.'

The first thing the world sees.

IG-1

The emblem, in the wild

The vessel-join emblem as the avatar: artery loop, vein loop, gold crossing — centered, breathing room, one subject.

Principle: the avatar is a symbol, not a lockup — detail dies at 110 px.

IG-2

The A, in the wild

The living A with the golden infinity crossbar, simplified to avatar scale — the letter still reads, the vessels still whisper.

Principle: build a distinct icon version of the mark for exactly this use.

IG-3

The circle-born loop

NEW — the infinity scaled so its outer curves follow the circle's edge: the loop born for the crop. Crimson half, petrol half, gold at the heart.

Principle: the circle is not a container, it is the frame — design inside it.

IG-4

The seal

NEW — the monogram A in a bold graphite ring: crimson and petrol diagonals, the gold infinity bar. A coin, a stamp, a guild badge.

Principle: monograms make the strongest avatars — letters survive shrinking.

IG-5

The negative-space disc

NEW — one crimson disc with the infinity carved out of it, the vein flowing through the artery's field, one gold dot at the crossing. The five-second draw test, passed by construction.

Principle: one shape + negative space = memorable; a stranger can draw it from memory.

LEVEL: MAXIMUM · THE SECOND WAVE

Five more, elevated to the max.

IG-1 is on the shortlist — and the level goes up: the perfected emblem, the twin discs, the full account system, and the name itself carrying the loop.

MAX-1

The definitive emblem

The vessel-join loop at maximum flat execution: organic curves, taper, lumen mouths, one branch, the gold suture ring.

The mark, perfected — every vessel cue earned.

MAX-2

The twin discs

Two bodies, one carved join: the infinity channelled through a crimson disc and a petrol disc, gold dot at the crossing.

One shape per vessel; the join is negative space.

MAX-3

The full system

Not just the avatar — the whole account: highlight covers as a glyph family, a designed post-template grid.

The brand is the system, not the mark.

MAX-4

The wordmark

The name carries its own anastomosis: the two O’s of anastOmosis are the infinity’s loops — crimson and petrol, joined behind the M.

Typography is the last mile of identity.

MAX-5

The founder’s cut, elevated

IG-1 taken to its absolute maximum — the flagship account a designer would screenshot.

Elevation is consistency: every pixel on brand.
